adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces at least two verifiable defects in the new `addGuestsHandler`: (1) authorization: `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&` between `isTeamAdmin(...)` and `isTeamOwner(...)` (so a team admin who is not also an owner will be denied), yet the subsequent gate is `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN`, which contradicts the stated intent of allowing team-admin access; (2) email routing input: the handler filters to `uniqueGuests` for DB insertion, but calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the original unfiltered `guests` array, so `sendAddGuestsEmails` may misclassify existing attendees/duplicates/blacklisted emails as “new guests” when deciding which template to send. The “no tests added” part is true but the above are concrete functional issues.
